comments: Confirm that the remaining no-transfer, multiple-transfer, Financial Asset Addendum, and Supplemental Doc fixtures may be resolved at PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION. Transaction 16809591 / document 16809592 is already observed for the single-transfer scenarios. Approving authorises implementation and execution of the six UI scenarios against approved plan TP-EC-11358-001 v2. Every locator remains MCP_VALIDATION_REQUIRED until Playwright MCP confirms it. TS-EC-11358-006 and TS-EC-11358-007 remain deferred and are not part of this approval.

itemDecisions.comment: A transferred financial asset shows a consolidated Control History table (AC-EC-11358-001, UI). Transaction 16809591 / document 16809592 is observed supporting evidence; locators remain pending Playwright MCP validation.
Each Control History row shows the transfer date and both organizations (AC-EC-11358-002, UI). Structural presence only; exact labels and date format are not asserted.
A document with no confirmed transfer shows no Control History table (AC-EC-11358-003, UI). The concrete no-transfer fixture remains to be resolved at PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION.
Multiple transfers are ordered newest to oldest (AC-EC-11358-004, UI). The concrete multiple-transfer fixture remains to be resolved at PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION.
The Control History table appears in the UI view (AC-EC-11358-005). This is authoritative executable coverage while both API scenarios remain deferred.

Document type determines whether the Control History table is produced (AC-EC-11358-006, UI). The Financial Asset Addendum and Supplemental Doc fixtures remain to be resolved at PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION.
